visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair tied in a bun, wearing a white graphic T-shirt, stands in a brightly lit indoor hallway. She faces the camera directly, speaking animatedly with varied facial expressions, appearing surprised and amused. (2) She holds up a physical photo book entitled '世界唯一的你' (The Only You in the World). She opens the book to reveal various printed photos and text sections while laughing and reacting to the content with the help of an off-screen individual. (3) The camera moves to a medium shot as she points at specific details inside the book, including a section labeled 'Author Introduction' which features a younger photo of her. A man in a green T-shirt and glasses appears briefly in the frame, participating in the mockery of the old book. (4) She then presents a large, rotating photo-cube featuring more old pictures, continuing her energetic narration and gestures of embarrassment. (5) The scene shifts to a young boy in a blue T-shirt sitting on a grey couch, intently browsing through the same photo book, while the camera focuses on his reactions to the images.
